name: smwmusic-tia-ai-a-em-v-low-cortisol-song-star-mix
title: TIA - Ai Đưa Em Về (Low Cortisol Song) (Star-mix)
description:
Did a short arrangement of Ai Đưa Em Về (aka the low cortisol meme starring Agnes Tachyon from Umamusume: Pretty Derby). Let's just say I love Tachyon a li'l too much. :)

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. Enables the Intro (INTRO Enabled)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ2. Skips the Intro (INTRO Skipped)

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. A# Minor (Original Pitch)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ2. B Minor (Custom Pitch)
